text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from a long trip out<n>with Taiki
Shuttle...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You—students over there! Stop right<n>where you are!
What?! Wait, I know that voice...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm part of the student council! What<n>do you think
you're doing out at this<n>hour—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Oh, it's just you, Taiki. And<n>who's that with
you?
Howdy, Air Groove! This here's my<n>trainer!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well, if your trainer's accompanying<n>you, I suppose
there's no issue. I'm<n>sure you asked for
permission before<n>leaving campus.

I apologize for keeping you. With<n>recent reports of
poor behavior<n>occurring off academy grounds, I
have to be especially vigilant.

You may be on your way, but please<n>go straight
back to your dorm. No<n>detours.

I hear ya loud and clear! Why not<n>come back with
me, Air Groove?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What? I still have my patrol to attend<n>to...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so you're makin' the rounds?<n>Then let me join
ya! Don't hog all the<n>fun for yourself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm not here to have fun, you know.<n>Hey, you're
her trainer—do something<n>about this!
choice_data_list: Let Taiki do what she wants.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: How could you allow this? You<n>good-for-nothing...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yay! I'm ready to give it a go! I hate<n>seein' ya toil
away on your<n>lonesome, Air Groove!

So don't ya worry one bit! I'll do the<n>job just how
I'm supposed to. I<n>really mean it—honest!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: All righty, let's get started!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hey, who put you in charge?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hey, you there! Stop! Yes, you in the<n>uniform!

Hm, you've already found a student<n>breaking
curfew? I may have<n>misjudged you...
Come join us on patrol!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What do you think you're doing?!<n>Make her return
to her dorm!<n>Seriously, this is giving me a
headache...

Taiki Shuttle does the best she can on<n>patrol duty
while Air Groove lectures<n>her.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So you're sayin' that's a no? Well, I<n>get where
you're coming from, with<n>the full moon already out
and all.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Guess we'll be leavin' now, Air<n>Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Good, go home and get some rest. As<n>for me, I
have my duties to get back<n>to...
Sniffle... It was nice seein' ya, AirGroove! Shame I couldn't join ya onpatrol!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
...If ya wanna change your mind,<n>now's the time!
I'm always down for<n>the cause!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I have no intention of doing anything<n>of the sort, so
go rest! If you're<n>simply looking for an excuse to
play,<n>we can arrange a future date.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I drag a reluctant Taiki Shuttle back to<n>the dorm,
making sure she calls it a<n>day.
